purpose: Inspect manifest, assets, prompts, commands, and document inventory using the repository host.
success_condition: JSON is printed with one manifest and an asset inventory.

purpose: Run SQLite integrity, foreign-key, asset-hash, format, endpoint, and application checks.
success_condition: The command exits zero and prints "ok": true.

purpose: Launch a detached loopback host from the repository runtime.
success_condition: The command exits zero and prints a local http://127.0.0.1 URL with a healthy capsule ID.

purpose: Confirm that the detached host is healthy.
success_condition: The command reports "running": true and the expected capsule identity.

purpose: Stop the detached loopback host for this capsule.
success_condition: The command reports that the host is no longer running.

purpose: When only the database is available, integrity-check and exclusively extract its embedded compatible host using Python's sqlite3 module.
command_template: {python} -c "import hashlib,pathlib,sqlite3,sys; c=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]); r=c.execute('SELECT content,sha256 FROM capsule_asset WHERE path=?',('bootstrap/capsule_host.py',)).fetchone(); b=r[0]; hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==r[1] or sys.exit('embedded host hash mismatch'); p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])/'capsule_host.py'; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); f=p.open('xb'); f.write(b); f.close(); print(p)" "{capsule}" "{cache}"
argv_json: import hashlib,pathlib,sqlite3,sys; c=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]); r=c.execute('SELECT content,sha256 FROM capsule_asset WHERE path=?',('bootstrap/capsule_host.py',)).fetchone(); b=r[0]; hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==r[1] or sys.exit('embedded host hash mismatch'); p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])/'capsule_host.py'; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); f=p.open('xb'); f.write(b); f.close(); print(p)
success_condition: A new capsule_host.py file is written under the selected cache directory; an existing target is never overwritten.

purpose: Execute the extracted host to verify the capsule before serving application assets.
success_condition: The extracted code exits zero and prints "ok": true.

purpose: Run the capsule using the extracted compatible host.
success_condition: The command exits and prints a healthy local loopback URL.

purpose: Confirm a database-only launch using the extracted compatible host.
success_condition: The command reports "running": true and the expected capsule identity.

purpose: Stop a database-only launch using the matching extracted host.
success_condition: The command reports that the host is no longer running.

purpose: Create a deterministic reviewable bundle from any capsule without executing its assets.
success_condition: A new deterministic authoring bundle is created and the source SHA-256 is reported.

purpose: Pack and verify a deterministic authoring bundle into a new capsule.
success_condition: A new capsule is created, fully verified, and its SHA-256 is reported.

purpose: Compare two capsules semantically by pragma, schema, and table rows.
success_condition: JSON reports whether the capsules are semantically equal and identifies bounded changes.

purpose: Rebuild and test the complete bootstrap after source changes.
command_template: {python} tools/build_example.py && {python} -m unittest discover -s tests -v && {python} tools/capsule.py verify "{capsule}" && {python} tools/build_example.py --check
success_condition: The example rebuilds, all tests pass, verification succeeds, and the checked distribution matches a fresh build.
